description: maria-v1 Issue 1 e2e: method-receiver autoborrow through a ref-returning rvalue base + field projection. Pins the customer-critical shape `w.get().handle.peek()` plus a bare-function variant `get_inner_ref(&inner).handle.peek()` and the lowering-equivalent baseline `val r = w.get(); r.handle.peek()`. All three shapes must compile AND produce the expected values at runtime — proving type-check, lowering (split-lift via stage1 borrow_materialize), and codegen agree. Sibling to `borrow_chained_ref_projection_noncopy` which pins the explicit `&w.get().handle` form (the 0.31.87 fix); this case pins the method-receiver autoborrow form. Scope cut: the HIndex variant `w.handles_ref()[i].method()` hits a separate v1 MIR-lowering limitation (`array index read requires Copy element type; borrow not supported in v1`) and is filed as a separate follow-up.
